description: List photos in one photo-capture submission. Each photo includes its id, review status, capturedAt, source (live_camera or upload), a view URL, and location lat/lng/accuracyM reported by the device and not verified. locationVerdict says inside or outside the bounty area; unknown means no location, and no_area means the bounty has no area. distanceMeters gives the measured distance when available. The response includes review counts and a page with nextCursor. Filters: all returns every photo; to_review returns pending photos; accepted or rejected selects that review state; outside_area selects photos outside the area; no_location selects photos without location data. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty the submission belongs to

cursor.description: Photo ID from nextCursor on the previous page

filter.description: Optional filter: all, to_review, accepted, rejected, outside_area, no_location. Omit it to use the server default (all).

submissionId.description: The unique ID of the photo-capture submission

name: list_submission_photos
title: List submission photos
